Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The stopping distance table extracted as clean text rows, so the fact blocks quote its rows as the manual's own figures [A03].
The manual prints the deceleration figure in feet per second rather than as a rate per second squared; the dossier repeats the figure exactly as printed and does not correct it [A03] (verify NJ-CTRL-D-DECEL).
The clock-face steering drawing, the K-turn drawing and the parallel parking curb drawing are images whose labels added no further values; no fact relies on them [A01] [A08].
The horn advice here, sounding it when passing outside business or residential zones, is narrower than the general horn advice in the vehicle-condition pages; each is reported as printed on its own page [A04].
Statute citations printed after each rule were summarized, not copied.
